summary: Roadmap 1.21 cue-marker and waveform integrity: eight protected markers with durable provenance, trusted v2 waveform caches, bounded waveform-only refresh, and guarded category relocation; roadmap 2.24 Monitoring layout improvements. Library 0099 adds marker state, revision and analysis-request fields; its two reviewed manual AddField operations require the immutable r0123 companion. Restart Gunicorn and the active-message worker; no static, unit, package, nginx or protected-runtime change.
